{{Quote|Captain Valek, we're approaching Communications Research Station Epsilon Nine.|Unidentified Imperial [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]]|<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire">{{GalaxyCite|3|Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire}}</ref>}}
'''Valek''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Revenant (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Revenant'']] during an [[Assault on Epsilon Nine|attack]] on [[Communications Research Station]] [[Epsilon Nine]] in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Though Captain Valek commanded the vessel he served under the command of [[Lumiya]], who was working in the name of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. The ''Revenant'' was only one part of [[Lumiya's fleet]]. Valek quickly deferred to Lumiya when she gave orders.<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire" />
